However, through this, you can achieve a tone that closely matches the video.

How to Use

a. Watch

Select the desired video from the list of drum performance videos or use the search function (coming soon) to find and watch videos.

b. Tune

Click the "Top Lug" button and the "Bottom Lug" button to tune while listening to each pitch, tuning until you reach the desired sound.

Precautions

Remove the snare drum and toms from the stands.
Place them on a surface like the floor or a rotating platform where the bottom is blocked.
Mute the bottom head using materials like towels to prevent it from vibrating, then proceed with tuning.

Measure & Customize

Introduction
Every drum in the world has varying tuning values due to differences in drum shell thickness, depth, and head types. As a result, the process of deriving information through measurements is necessary for each drum.
Using the 12 relative pitches from lower to upper octaves for the same note, users can obtain values that allow them to tune to their desired fundamental pitch.

Getting Started

Select the "Measure & Customize" mode.
Press the Save (floppy disk-shaped) button to input and save the name of the Drum Kit or individual drums.
One set of saved data consists of groups like Snare Drum, 10”, 12”, 13”, 14”, 16”, 18” Tom Drum.

Measuring

Choose the type of drum you want to measure. Two measurements are needed for each drum. 
For the first measurement, try pressing the Top and Bottom buttons suggested by the app. 
The signal generator will run, allowing you to hear the pitch. 
Adjust the Top Lug Pitch and Bottom Lug Pitch until they match the same note. Note down the Fundamental value after measuring.
For the second measurement, tune the Top Lug Pitch and Bottom Lug Pitch to the values suggested by the app. Note down the Fundamental value after measuring.
Once the measurement is complete, press the Save button to overwrite and save the data.

Using

After measurement, below the screen, values for tuning to your desired Fundamental Pitch are listed, spanning 12 different relative pitches from lower to upper octaves for the same note.
Touch each value manually, and the Signal Generator will play, allowing you to hear the pitch.
For more precise tuning, you can use the Adjustment feature to correct any discrepancies.
The video below demonstrates the tuning process for adjusting the G3 note by a minor third after measurement.

Precautions

If the thickness of the head changes, you need to measure and save again.

Kraftwerk employed the Minimoog Model D on the successful concept album Autobahn, sparking an entirely new genre. Gary Numan replaced his live band’s guitars with Minimoog Model Ds, creating the prototype for industrial music.
